title: Endowment Effect
coreMove: Name the endowment effect in the room, then redesign the next choice so it cannot choose for you.
sourcePressure: The source sidecar and official source notes frame Endowment Effect as a specific decision error around endowment, ownership, asking price. Traceable support includes , 127 - 138. The coffee mugs: Daniel Kahneman, Jack Knetsch and Richard Thaler.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating Endowment Effect as generic advice to be smarter, instead of forcing this exact move: name the endowment effect in the room, then redesign the next choice so it cannot choose for you.
